result.instructions: Tools for Proposify, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "List the proposal templates of my Proposify account."; "Which of my documents are archived?"; "Create a client Jane Doe at the company Acme Ltd.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Proposify data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run proposify_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run proposify_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run proposify_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. proposify_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: proposify_list_templates
tools.title: List templates
tools.description: The account's proposal templates: id and name. Use the id as fromTemplateId in proposify_create_document.

tools.name: proposify_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: The users of the account: id, email, first name, last name and title.

tools.name: proposify_list_companies
tools.title: List companies
tools.description: The account's companies (client organisations). Filter by id or name.

tools.name: proposify_list_clients
tools.title: List clients
tools.description: The account's clients (people): id, company, name, email. Filter by id, company, name or email.

tools.name: proposify_list_documents
tools.title: List documents or templates
tools.description: The v3 documents or templates of the account, with their ids, names, status and dates.

contentType.description: documents = the proposals; templates = the template documents.

tools.name: proposify_get_document
tools.title: Get a document
tools.description: One v3 document by id: name, status, locked flag, dates, creator, last editor and its content data.

id.description: The v3 document id (a string), as listed by proposify_list_documents.

tools.name: proposify_list_sections
tools.title: List content-library sections
tools.description: The sections of the content library (reusable blocks): id, name, sort order and path. Use the id as section_id in proposify_add_document_section.

tools.name: proposify_create_company
tools.title: Create a company
tools.description: WRITE: creates a company (a client organisation) in the account. Creates a record; it does not check for duplicates.

country.description: The country code the API expects (for example US).

tools.name: proposify_update_company
tools.title: Update a company
tools.description: WRITE: changes a company's name or address. Only the fields you give are sent.

country.description: The country code the API expects (for example US).

tools.name: proposify_create_client
tools.title: Create a client
tools.description: WRITE: creates a client (a person) in the account, optionally inside a company. Creates a record; it does not check for duplicates.

use_company_address.description: true = use the company's address; false = use the address given here.

country.description: The country code the API expects (for example US).

tools.name: proposify_update_client
tools.title: Update a client
tools.description: WRITE: changes a client's name, contact details, company or address. Only the fields you give are sent.

country.description: The country code the API expects (for example US).

tools.name: proposify_create_document
tools.title: Create a document
tools.description: WRITE: creates a v3 document (a proposal) with the given name, optionally from a template. It does not send the document to anyone.

fromTemplateId.description: A template id from proposify_list_templates (a number) or proposify_list_documents (a string).

expiryDate.description: The expiry date the API expects (ISO 8601).

tools.name: proposify_update_document
tools.title: Update a document
tools.description: WRITE: changes a v3 document's name, folder or expiry date. It cannot delete or unlock a document. Only the fields you give are sent.

id.description: The v3 document id (a string), as listed by proposify_list_documents.

expiryDate.description: The expiry date the API expects (ISO 8601).

tools.name: proposify_add_document_section
tools.title: Add a section to a document
tools.description: WRITE: adds a content-library section to a document, optionally at a given position.

id.description: The document id as an integer (v1 endpoints only). The v3 ids from proposify_list_documents are strings.

order.description: The position of the section in the document.

annotations.title: Add a section to a document

tools.name: proposify_set_document_custom_fields
tools.title: Set a document's custom fields
tools.description: WRITE: sets or changes custom field values on a document (by field name). Other custom fields are kept.

id.description: The document id as an integer (v1 endpoints only). The v3 ids from proposify_list_documents are strings.

tools.name: proposify_archive_document
tools.title: Archive a document
tools.description: WRITE: archives a document (it leaves the active list). proposify_unarchive_document brings it back.

id.description: The document id as an integer (v1 endpoints only). The v3 ids from proposify_list_documents are strings.

tools.name: proposify_unarchive_document
tools.title: Unarchive a document
tools.description: WRITE: brings an archived document back to the active list.

id.description: The document id as an integer (v1 endpoints only). The v3 ids from proposify_list_documents are strings.
